versions.title: First round
notes: Search (route, anywhere, flexible dates), results ranked by £ per tier point, fare detail, Gold progress.
Layout A is a ranked list; layout B adds a price-against-tier-points chart above it.
Loading, no-earning-fares and error states are in the screen index.

versions.title: Simpler search, black glass
notes: Search is just Where to? and When; origin defaults to London and changes with one tap.
One date picker: one tap is one way, a second tap adds the return; tap the return again to drop it, Clear resets.
White page with black glass controls, one orange accent for the best value.
Anywhere lives in the Where to? suggestions; flexible dates are the £/TP switch inside the calendar; cabin and Gold sit quietly aside.
Gold target is 20,000 tier points; Vueling fares show only under Iberia flight numbers.
One layout; the A/B switch and chart are gone. New plane logo and favicon.

versions.title: flick.fan inverse, Skiplagged-style results
notes: Built on the live sam.toys/flights page (sam-toys main 59c8580) with sample data in place of /api/flights; every live screen and behaviour is kept.

Design system is the light inverse of flick.fan (flicfix main 27229dd): same Geist type scale, 68px pill search with a round go button, label-left filter rows, 28px glass panels, pill controls; paper page, ink text and ink primary buttons, one warm accent used only for tier points.

Results follow Sam's Skiplagged references (take-off/landing histograms with two-handle sliders, flight cards, Stops radios with from-prices): sort tabs Best value, Cheapest, Fastest, Most tier points; each card shows price and +TP together, then £/TP and Avios; filters sit in a side column on desktop and behind one Filters button on phone.
Anywhere from London no longer lists London; city names are in English (Florence, Frankfurt, Munich, Lisbon).
Plane logo is now an ink glyph beside a flick-style 'flights.' wordmark; favicon matches.

fix: search any route. Go and Enter always search: a typed city or code is used even when no suggestion was picked, the calendar closes, and anything that can't search says why. Routes without hand-made samples (New York → Heathrow, London → Tokyo, Ibiza → Heathrow) get generated oneworld and BA-partner fares.

versions.title: Home: origin pills, open calendar; skip-last-leg; nearby dates
notes: Built on live sam.toys/flights (sam-toys main d06ada5) with sample data; screens other than home and results are unchanged from live.

Home: the search pill stays as is. Below it on one row: a take-off glyph with London · Ibiza · a type-a-city pill on the left (last used origin is remembered; first visit London), Cabin on the right. The From, When and Cabin rows are gone.
The calendar is always open under that row, compact and without its own panel: one tap one way, a second tap return, Clear, £/TP toggle. On phone a full-width Search button sits under the calendar.

Skip-last-leg fares: a 'Skip last leg' chip in the card's tag slot, the skipped final leg drawn dashed and greyed to the ticketed city, 'Ticketed to BCN · get off at MAD' under the airline, and a Show · Hide · Only filter.

Results: a ±3-day strip under the route header with the cheapest price per day from flex data in the searched cabin; the cheapest nearby day is ringed with ↓; tapping a day re-searches and keeps the trip length; arrows move a week.
Long business and first fares (five-digit £ and TP) fit the card's right column at 1440 and 390 (matches the flights-card-fit hotfix).
